channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Remembering towering civil rights leader Jesse Jackson
item.description: Jesse Jackson marched with Martin Luther King and built a rainbow coalition driven by the power of hope.

item.title: US political leaders pay tribute to civil rights activist Jesse Jackson
item.description: Tributes to civil rights leader Jesse Jackson have come from across the political spectrum in the United States.

item.title: Unemployment surges to 5.2% – UK youth hit hardest
item.description: UK unemployment has risen to its highest for almost five years, as new figures from the Office for National Statistics show the rate went up to 5.2% in the last quarter of 2025.

item.title: Why is finding work so difficult for Britain’s youth?
item.description: We spoke to Allen Simpson, who's chief executive of UK hospitality, and Emma Greenwood, who's in her final year of university and has spent nine months looking for a job.

item.title: Jesse ‘passing the baton’ says former Rev Jackson coalition member
item.description: We spoke to Reverend Gregory Seal Livingston - who had a senior role in the Rev Jackson's Rainbow Push coalition.

item.title: Reform UK announces self-styled ‘shadow cabinet’
item.description: Nigel Farage has begun shaping the team that he says would make up his Cabinet if Reform UK win a General Election.

item.title: Microdramas: why vertical cliffhanger social videos are booming
item.description: Now in this world of constant scrolling and busted attention spans, it's no surprise that the latest trend in video entertainment is all about the microdrama.

item.title: Second person contacts Cabinet Office to warn against appointment of Dame Antonia Romeo
item.description: A second individual has contacted the Cabinet Office to warn against the appointment of Dame Antonia Romeo as the new Cabinet Secretary.

item.title: ‘A new window has opened’ for US nuclear deal says Iran
item.description: Iran's foreign minister says "a new window has opened" for reaching a deal with the US, after their latest round of indirect talks in Geneva.

item.title: Nottingham attacks inquiry: What state are UK mental health services in?
item.description: A statutory inquiry will open next week into Valdo Calocane, who killed three people and left three others seriously injured in a brutal attack in Nottingham in June 2023.
